answer: Each challenge is derived only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature makes the beacon unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward. A participant commits to a response before the pulse, then reveals it for checking against the beacon-bound task. This timing blocks advance computation and cheap offline farming by sybil swarms; varied tasks may test a prism, identify a relic, or navigate an oasis, while identity limits and response costs still matter.
